latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AgentPulse skill for LLM cost and performance tracking.

- Track LLM API costs, tokens, latency, and errors for OpenClaw agents via AgentPulse.
- Report every LLM API call in real time with silent, background event posting.
- Answer questions on API usage, spend, errors, common models, and latency from AgentPulse stats.
- Guide users through AgentPulse setup and alert configuration when asked.
- No prompt/personal data is sent, only usage metadata.
